name: build-a-racetrack
description: Build A Racetrack - build, drive and upgrade your own racetrack with five friends on Bloxity (Three.js + Colyseus)

scripts.dev: npm run build:shared && concurrently -n server,client -c magenta,cyan "npm:dev:server" "npm:dev:client"
scripts.build: npm run build:shared && npm run build --workspace @race/server && npm run build --workspace @race/client
scripts.build:client: npm run build:shared && npm run build --workspace @race/client
scripts.build:server: npm run build:shared && npm run build --workspace @race/server
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:shared && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
scripts.verify: npm run build:server && node scripts/verify-track.mjs && node scripts/verify-movement.mjs && node scripts/verify-assets.mjs && node scripts/verify-persistence.mjs && node scripts/verify-offline.mjs
scripts.verify:movement: npm run build -w shared && node scripts/verify-movement.mjs
